name: updateIntroScreen
description: Changes the introduction screen's text, which locations it shows and their order.

description.description: The text shown on the introduction screen, HTML formatting kept. Leave it out to keep the current text, or leave it empty to remove it.

sorting.description: The order of locations on the introduction screen. Leave it out to keep the current order; it can't be removed.

locationSource.description: Which locations the introduction screen shows. Leave it out to keep the current source; it can't be removed.

areaLatitude.description: Latitude of the local area's center, used by the Local Area source. Leave it out to keep the current center; it changes only together with areaLongitude.

areaLongitude.description: Longitude of the local area's center. Leave it out to keep the current center; it changes only together with areaLatitude.

areaAddress.description: The address shown for the local area's center. Leave it out to keep the current one; it can't be removed, and it changes only together with both coordinates.

areaRadiusMiles.description: How far around the center the local area reaches, 1 to 200 miles. Leave it out to keep the current radius; it can't be removed.

callback.description: Runs when it's done, with the saved introduction screen.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as when nothing to change is passed or a setting that can't be removed is left empty.

introScreen.description: The introduction screen settings as saved.
